privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.body:
Ochaworth Leadership and Community Development Initiative ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy. This page explains, in plain terms, what information we collect through this website and how we use it.

When you fill out a form on this site — for example to volunteer, become a member, donate, or contact us — we collect the details you provide, such as your name, email address, and phone number. We use this information only to respond to your request, process your donation or application, and keep you updated about our programmes if you've asked to hear from us.

We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share information with trusted partners who help us run our programmes (for example, a payment processor for donations), but only as needed to provide our services.

You can ask us at any time to see what information we hold about you, to correct it, or to have it deleted, by reaching out through our Contact page.

This is a general starting policy. Please have it reviewed by a qualified professional before relying on it as your organisation's official privacy policy.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.body:
These terms govern your use of the Ochaworth Leadership and Community Development Initiative website. By using this site, you agree to these terms.

The content on this site — including text, photos, and programme information — is provided for general informational purposes about our work and how to get involved. While we do our best to keep it accurate and up to date, we cannot guarantee that every detail is current at all times.

Donations made through this site go directly toward supporting our programmes, subject to our organisation's donation and refund practices. If you have questions about a donation, please contact us directly.

You agree to use this website only for lawful purposes and not to misuse any form, submission, or content on the site.

This is a general starting template. Please have it reviewed by a qualified professional before relying on it as your organisation's official terms of service.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.body:
This website may use basic cookies and similar technologies to help it function properly and to understand, in a general way, how visitors use the site.

Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We use them for things like remembering your preferences and helping our site run smoothly. We do not use cookies to sell your personal information.

Most web browsers let you control cookies through their settings, including blocking or deleting them. Doing so may affect how some parts of this site work.

This is a general starting template. Please have it reviewed by a qualified professional before relying on it as your organisation's official cookie policy.
